desc:
🛹 Skate Through an Epic Trick Obby!

⚡ Jump to automatically perform awesome tricks and experience maximum skateboarding action!
🚀 Grind rails, ride ziplines, and master a variety of exciting obstacles across 100+ challenges.
⭐ Unlock G-SHOCK-inspired skateboards and items as you play.
🌈 Equip your favorite boards and trails, and show off your unique style while cruising through the world.

🏆 Race alongside friends or compete for a top spot on the leaderboard.
🔥 Challenge yourself again and again, conquer every course, and aim for the fastest finish! 🛹⚡️
